day.headline: A Rabbit day — Goat and Pig are in step.

reasons: Pig and Rabbit share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Last one out and the quiet's all yours. Start something.

reasons: Rabbit's own day — your energy runs high
signs.motif: a floor that needs one sweep
signs.message: Grab the broom, one lap, done. The room changes instantly.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Rabbit — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the app opened without deciding to
signs.message: Your thumb went there by itself. Move it off the homescreen today.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Rabbit — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a film paused for twenty minutes
signs.message: Twenty minutes frozen on the same frame. Sit down, finish it.

reasons: Rooster opposes Rabbit — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: a yes you have not said out loud
signs.message: It's a yes and you know it. Say it aloud today.

reasons: Dog pairs with Rabbit — a harmonious day
signs.message: Three deep at the counter. Worth the wait, stay put.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Rabbit — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Skip the menu spiral. The usual, again, no apology.

reasons: Ox sits apart from Rabbit — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Up before the light. Make something hot, no rushing.

reasons: Goat and Rabbit share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: The sun finds your window at four. Be there, do nothing.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Rabbit — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Nobody's opened it since you sent it. Let that stay true.

signs.motif: the good coat for no occasion
signs.message: No occasion worthy of it tonight. It keeps hanging, happily.

signs.message: The nice one stays capped today. Nothing needs your best handwriting.
